commands.0: arm on an open subscription; one lease per Runtime
commands.2: release schedules normal deliver; repeated release is idempotent while handle remains valid; releasing before arrival disarms

delivery.units: booleans for fields1..4, cumulative lease/event counts for5..7
delivery.close: Held lease retains the real Core inFlight owner. Stop/close stays pending until normal release/invoke or actual env cleanup discards. Retired handles retain normal InvalidHandleRetired/Closed semantics.

cases.0: unchanged real Engine handle: accepts, creates no operation
cases.2: different generation: InvalidHandleRetired; use second Engine for an actual prior generation
cases.6: real observation key of another currently-live env: WrongEnv; uses caller valid napi_env, no foreign Engine dereference

admission.scope: Runs actual shared handle()/find(expected=e,requireOpen=true), not full submit. Lab compares real Core/provider/work baselines. Invalid format/case or nonforeign key is a fixture error, not a promised negative rejection.
